english.title: Distributor fail to ensure storage / transport of pyrotechnic did not jeopardise safety (not cat F1/F2/F3 firework)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the distributor, failed to ensure that, while

(A)_[a pyrotechnic article other than a category F1, F2 or F3 firework,]_
(B)_[pyrotechnic articles other than category F1, F2 or F3 fireworks,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY PYROTECHNIC ARTICLE(S)..),

(C)_[was]_
(D)_[were]_

under your responsibility, the storage or transport conditions of

(E)_[the article]_
(F)_[those articles]_

did not jeopardise

(G)_[its]_
(H)_[their]_

conformity with the essential safety requirements
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 29, 62(3)(f) and 63(1) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12382 (CJS code PA15125)
